title: Phoenix Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Make a controller reply
examples.description: The router maps GET /hello to a controller action. text sends a plain response.
examples.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/hello", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def hello(conn, _params), do: text(conn, "Hello, Asha!")
end

examples.title: Read a path value
examples.description: A colon marks a router input. Pattern matching reads its string-keyed parameter. Open GET /hello/Ravi.
examples.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/hello/:name", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def hello(conn, %{"name" => name}), do: text(conn, "Hi, #{name}!")
end

examples.title: Check a path number
examples.description: Integer.parse reads a number and the unused text. Open GET /double/4.
examples.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/double/:n", LessonController, :twice
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def twice(conn, %{"n" => raw}) do
 case Integer.parse(raw) do
  {n, ""} -> json(conn, %{answer: n * 2})
  _ -> conn |> put_status(400) |> json(%{error: "Use a whole number"})
 end
end
end

examples.title: Read JSON parameters
examples.description: Send POST /books with application/json and {"title":"Moon Trip"}. The endpoint parser puts the fields into params.
examples.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
post "/books", LessonController, :create
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def create(conn, %{"title" => title}) when is_binary(title), do: conn |> put_status(201) |> json(%{title: title})
def create(conn, _params), do: conn |> put_status(400) |> json(%{error: "Title needed"})
end

examples.title: Return a redirect
examples.description: redirect sends a location. A browser following GET /start reaches /hello.
examples.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/start", LessonController, :start
get "/hello", LessonController, :hello
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def start(conn, _params), do: redirect(conn, to: "/hello")
def hello(conn, _params), do: text(conn, "Welcome")
end

examples.title: Stop later processing
examples.description: halt marks the connection so later plugs stop. Open GET /closed.
examples.code:
# lib/school_web/router.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.Router do
 use SchoolWeb, :router
 pipeline :api do
  plug :accepts, ["json"]
 end
 scope "/", SchoolWeb do
  pipe_through :api
get "/closed", LessonController, :closed
 end
end

# lib/school_web/controllers/lesson_controller.ex
defmodule SchoolWeb.LessonController do
 use SchoolWeb, :controller
def closed(conn, _params), do: conn |> send_resp(403, "Closed for practice") |> halt()
end
